items.title: IEX Q2 Deep Dive: Data Center and Semiconductor Demand Drive Momentum, Guidance Raised
items.summary: Manufacturing company IDEX (NYSE:IEX) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 6.4% year on year to $920.6 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was optimistic at $931.4 million at the midpoint, 2.1% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.32 per share was 10.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
